english.note: Use this as the all-purpose colloquial choice for physically getting free or getting away, especially from capture; when escape means avoiding something, it covers only avoiding capture.

examples.english: I finally managed to escape from the people chasing me.
examples.traditional: 我終於走甩嗰班追緊我嘅人。
